200.title: Ukraine, Poland explore joint FIFA World Cup bid
200.summary: News Politics Ukraine, Poland explore joint FIFA World Cup bid Kyiv hopes to repeat its successful Euro 2012 partnership with Warsaw, according to the country’s sports minister.
200.body: News Politics Ukraine, Poland explore joint FIFA World Cup bid Kyiv hopes to repeat its successful Euro 2012 partnership with Warsaw, according to the country’s sports minister. Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. | Pool photo by Mandel Ngan/Getty Images Exclusive September 4, 2026 4:02 am CET By Martina Sapio Ukraine and Poland are weighing up a joint bid to host the biggest sporting event on the planet: the men’s FIFA World Cup. Vasyl Mokan, a member of Ukraine’s parliament and deputy chair of its Committee on Youth and Sports, said the committee had not received official information confirming that discussions over a possible bid had taken place — though he called the proposal “both compelling and full of potential.” “A joint FIFA World Cup bid by Ukraine and Poland would be much more than a major sporting event,” he said.

400.body: Heerema Marine Contractors has completed the offshore foundation installation campaign for the Bałtyk 2 and Bałtyk 3 wind farms in the Baltic Sea. 500.title: OpenAI Says GPT-6 Astra Is 'The Most Intelligent And Aligned Model In The World'
500.summary: News AI OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra is 'the most intelligent and aligned model in the world' The new frontier model is particularly competent at agentic, computer-use tasks.
500.body: News AI OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra is 'the most intelligent and aligned model in the world' The new frontier model is particularly competent at agentic, computer-use tasks. GPT-6 Astra excels at computer-use and browsing, and handling tasks in the domains of software engineering, cybersecurity, science and general professional work, according to OpenAI. OpenAI says the model scored a perfect score on ExploitBench, a benchmark for determining a model's ability to exploit software vulnerabilities, which was a big jump up from GPT-5.6 Sol's score of 78.5%. OpenAI says that GPT-6 Astra is "rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API and AWS." For developers using the OpenAI API, Astra costs $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.
